report:
Ampulla of Vater, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)

Received in formalin is a pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection) specimen measuring 150 x 90 x 60 mm. The pancreatic head measures 55 x 45 x 35 mm, the attached duodenum measures 150 mm in length and the common bile duct measures 40 mm in length. The pancreatic neck, bile duct, uncinate (superior mesenteric artery) and posterior surfaces are inked in different colours and the neck and bile duct margins are taken en face. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the ampulla of Vater measuring 26 x 22 x 15 mm. The common bile duct is dilated to 16 mm and the pancreatic duct is dilated to 5 mm. The ampulla is bisected along the probed common bile duct and pancreatic duct and embedded in full. The lymph node stations are dissected separately and submitted in labelled cassettes. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-6) Ampulla, bisected along the probed ducts.
(7) Pancreatic neck margin, en face.
(8) Bile duct margin, en face.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)
- Origin: Ampullary (centred on the ampulla of Vater, including intra-ampullary
  and periampullary-duodenal)
- Tumour site: Intra-ampullary
- Tumour size: 2.6 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma, pancreaticobiliary-type
- Histologic grade: G3, poorly differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, pancreaticobiliary-type,
  invading the pancreas to a depth of 0.9 cm. Simple angulated glands and small
  cell clusters lined by a single layer of cuboidal to low columnar cells are
  set in desmoplastic stroma, the nuclei round with prominent nucleoli and
  without pseudostratification. The tumour cells express CK7 and MUC1 and are
  negative for CDX2.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Invades the pancreas (depth 0.9 cm)
- Depth of pancreatic invasion: 0.9 cm
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Present
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Precursor lesion: Intra-ampullary papillary-tubular neoplasm (IAPN)

Margins
- Pancreatic neck (transection) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 15 mm
- Bile duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 20 mm
- Uncinate (retroperitoneal / superior mesenteric artery) margin: Uninvolved by
  invasive carcinoma, 6 mm
- Posterior surface: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 5 mm
- Proximal (gastric or duodenal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 50 mm
- Distal (duodenal or jejunal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 55 mm
- Pancreatic duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 14 mm
- Duodenal mucosal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 48 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 19 examined; 4 involved
  - Number examined: 19
  - Number involved: 4
  - Stations involved: 12 (hepatoduodenal ligament): 1 and 13 (posterior
    pancreaticoduodenal): 3
  - Extranodal extension: Present
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 11 mm, station 13

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3b pN2
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIIB

Additional findings
- Ampullary adenoma

AMPULLA OF VATER, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple
resection)
- ADENOCARCINOMA, pancreaticobiliary-type, poorly differentiated, 2.6 cm,
  invading the pancreas to a depth of 0.9 cm; lymphovascular invasion present;
  perineural invasion present; remaining margins clear (closest 5 mm); see
  synoptic report
- 4 of 19 regional lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present
- pT3b pN2 (AJCC 8th edition), stage IIIB (if cM0)
